title: Chat / messaging
description: 1:1 and group threads with deferred attachments, timestamps, delivery receipts, long-press emoji reactions, member-scoped rules, and push fan-out to other members.
notes: onChatMessageCreated notifies other thread members via Expo push / FCM when device tokens exist.
Members are stored as memberIds: string[] on each thread.
Attachments are picked locally and uploaded to users/{uid}/chat/{threadId}/… only on Send, together with any caption text.
Emoji reactions live on message.reactions; rules allow members to update that field only.
